notes: two sayings: the second («وسمعت محمد بن عبد الله بن محمد بن طيفور يقول») has its own isnad and is not written as a route
the text is cut mid-sentence («مع علمه»)
«عن عمه محمد بن أبي القاسم»: the uncle is dropped and the name stands alone
«أبي عبد الله» is written after «عن» inside the chain, so it is a narrator, not imam_in_text
